description: Manifest for Player Character data: species (Ancestries), Classes/Subclasses, and Talents.

files.description: All 11 Ancestries with starting Characteristics, Size, and Ancestry Traits (including Beastfolk Adaptations and Undead Archetypes).
Base Classes and their Subclasses: index file plus one file per Class (Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Priest, Artificer).
Talent system rules plus Generic, Specialization, Animal Companion, and per-Class Talent lists.
